title: Meta rolls out new features for its Ray-Ban Display glasses, including neural handwriting support for all users, and opens the device to third-party developers (Jay Peters/The Verge)
summary: Jay Peters / The Verge: Meta rolls out new features for its Ray-Ban Display glasses, including neural handwriting support for all users, and opens the device to third-party developers — You can also now capture a video combining what you see on the lens display, what you see in the world, and the audio around you.
